local function before(a, b)
    return a.priority < b.priority or (a.priority == b.priority and a.sequence < b.sequence)
end

local heap = {}

local function push(task)
    heap[#heap + 1] = task
    local child = #heap
    while child > 1 do
        local parent = child // 2
        if not before(heap[child], heap[parent]) then break end
        heap[child], heap[parent] = heap[parent], heap[child]
        child = parent
    end
end

local function pop()
    local task = heap[1]
    local last = table.remove(heap)
    if #heap > 0 then
        heap[1] = last
        local parent = 1
        while 2 * parent <= #heap do
            local child = 2 * parent
            if child < #heap and before(heap[child + 1], heap[child]) then child = child + 1 end
            if not before(heap[child], heap[parent]) then break end
            heap[child], heap[parent] = heap[parent], heap[child]
            parent = child
        end
    end
    return task
end

local operations = {
    "add email 3", "add backup 5", "add deploy 1", "run", "add report 3", "add test 2",
    "add lint 3", "run", "run", "add cleanup 5", "add review 2", "run", "add build 1", "add docs 4",
    "run", "run",
}
for sequence, operation in ipairs(operations) do
    local parts = {}
    for part in operation:gmatch("%S+") do parts[#parts + 1] = part end
    if parts[1] == "add" then
        push({name = parts[2], priority = tonumber(parts[3]), sequence = sequence})
    else
        local task = pop()
        io.write(string.format("run: %s (priority %d)\n", task.name, task.priority))
    end
end
local remaining = {}
while #heap > 0 do remaining[#remaining + 1] = pop().name end
io.write("remaining: ", table.concat(remaining, " "), "\n")
